_note: JDK 25 default GC vs G1 on one CPU, full cross with AppCDS (on/off) and compact object headers (on/off). Base cells: default_untuned (no flags), default_small (Serial, pinned 128m), g1_small (G1, pinned 128m). On 1 CPU the JDK 25 default is Serial (G1 needs 2+ CPUs and ~1792MB); expected_gc makes the harness fail any run where the JVM picked something else. appcds=true: the harness primes a dynamic archive per combo per batch and maps it with -Xshare:on (see run_experiment.py). HEAP_CACHE_SIZE=120000 adds ~20MB of resident objects (measured ~169 B/entry on top of a 43.9MB baseline live set, 2026-09-25), for ~64MB live without compact headers: 50% of the 128m heap. No GC tuning flags. default_small_aa duplicates default_small to measure run-to-run noise and is not crossed.
